/factories.title: Our factories in Elche | Amble
/factories.description: Two family-run factories in Elche, Spain, eleven minutes apart, make every pair of Amble shoes.
p: Elche has made shoes for a hundred years. Two family-run factories here, eleven minutes apart, make every pair we sell.
Four steps, two buildings, about three days from hide to box.
Uppers are cut by hand from full hides and recycled knit, a few pairs at a time, so nothing is wasted on the bench.
Four stitchers join every upper in the first factory. The tomato heel tab goes on last, by the same hands.
Eleven minutes across town, the second factory presses the foam soles and lets them cool overnight before they are trimmed.
Each upper is pulled over a wooden last and joined to its sole by hand. Court 78 is stitched, never only glued.
We were making shoes for other people’s names for thirty years. Now our own name is on the inside of the tongue.
Carmen and Javi run the first factory, where every upper is cut and stitched.
Court 78 is stitched to its sole, so when the tread wears through we can take it off and stitch on a new one in the same room it was made in. Send them back, and they come home in about two weeks.
Ask for a free label, box them up, drop them at the post office.
The old sole is cut away and a new one is stitched on by hand.
Cleaned, re-laced and posted home, ready for the next ten years.

/fit.title: Find your size | Amble
/fit.description: Measure your foot in two minutes and find your size in every Amble shoe.
p: Measure your foot in two minutes and we will tell you your size in every shoe we make.
Take your size in the Daily and Tempo. In the Court 78, size down if you are between sizes.
Put a sheet of paper on a hard floor with one short edge against a wall. Stand on it in the socks you usually wear, heel touching the wall.
Ask someone to mark the tip of your longest toe with a pencil held straight up. It is not always the big toe.
Measure from the wall to the mark and slide the plate above to that length. Measure both feet and use the longer one.
Foot length to size. Between two lengths, take the larger one.
True to size with a snug heel. Between sizes, go up one for long runs.
True to size. Roomy toe box; wide feet are fine in your usual size. Whole sizes 6 to 13.
True to size. A slightly narrower midfoot holds you on descents.
Runs a little large, so between sizes go down one. Stiff for the first week, then it softens to your foot.
True to size. Between sizes, size down for a closer fit.
True to size, with a little room to grow. Measure their foot on our size guide.
